text:
Leah: Sharing final launch video stills from our partner for quick review — need brand lock, quote wording, and transcript consistency. Quick eyes?
Marcos: Uploading screenshots + transcript snippet now — https://files.redwood.ai/partnerX/stills_v3.zip
DesignOps: saw frame_03 — logo sits inside the 8px safe margin on the left, bleed looks tight. Recommend 16:9 export with 24px clearspace.
Sophia (Legal): quick flag — transcript line at 0:42 uses phrase "real-time 10x faster". Do we have a benchmark source? Legal will need citation or softened language (eg. "up to 10x faster").
Amir: Partner is pretty firm on the "10x" claim from their internal bench. I'll ask for the benchmark link, but we should prep an "up to 10x" caption option.
Leah: ok, pls ask partner for the benchmark PDF. Meanwhile can design prepare a caption variant and a corrected still with logo spacing?
DesignOps: will mock two variants in Figma (exact-claim + softened). Also exporting 16:9 master. Files: frame_01_master.png, frame_03_master.png, frame_03_logo_fix.png
DesignOps-bot: overlay-check report: frame_03_master.png -> logo clearspace violation at left (24px required). See red overlay attached.
Sophia (Legal): thanks. If partner can't provide a public benchmark, we need the "up to" language. Also confirm we can include partner quote attribution (they used "Redwood made integration seamless"). Need permission for that quote (copy of approval).
Marcos: forwarding partner response in thread, they said they'll share bench PDF by EOD and sign off on quote permission.
Leah: great. If legal + design sign off, can we aim to push updated stills + transcript copy to marketplace listing tomorrow morning?
DesignOps: yes — I'll post final exports to the same folder and ping ops when ready.
Sophia (Legal): tentatively ok. Final sign-off when updated transcript and logo spacing patched. :thumbsup:
Amir: I'll follow up with partner now, will update here.
Leah: awesome — thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround :)
